products.name: 12-Factor app support
products.description: 12-Factor app support includes several Charmcraft and Rockcraft extensions and the paas-charm library to make the crafting of 12-factor applications easier.

products.name: Aproxy
products.description:
Aproxy forwards TCP proxy requests with the hostname.
It achieves compliance with proxies requiring destination hostname for access control.

products.name: Backup
products.description:
The Backup product provides an easy-to-use, highly integrated backup solution
for charms in Juju, built on top of the Bacula backup system.

It includes a server charm managing all Bacula server components (Director,
Storage Daemon, and Baculum web UI), a subordinate File Daemon charm deployed
alongside workloads to be backed up, and an integrator charm that brokers
backup relations on behalf of other charms.

products.name: Chrony
products.description:
The Chrony operators deploy and manage the Chrony NTP server and client
across a range of environments, providing time provision and synchronisation
with NTP servers.

The chrony charm acts as an NTP server, while the chrony-client subordinate
charm configures Chrony as an NTP client on any principal charm, replacing
the system default NTP client.

products.name: Cloudflared
products.description:
Cloudflared is a lightweight daemon that routes traffic through Cloudflare's global network,
enabling secure, reliable access to applications without exposing infrastructure directly to the internet.

products.name: Content Cache K8s
products.description:
A Juju charm deploying and managing a content caching service in Kubernetes built on top of Nginx.
It is configurable to cache any HTTP or HTTPS web site and is useful for building
content delivery networks (CDN).

products.name: Content cache operators
products.description:
The Content Cache Operators provide a static web content cache backed by nginx.
The ``content-cache`` machine charm manages the nginx instance, while the
``content-cache-backends-config`` subordinate charm provides configuration for
the backend services to expose behind the cache.

products.name: Digest Squid auth helper
products.description: A Juju subordinate charm for the Squid reverse proxy charm that enables digest or basic authentication using squid-auth-helper relation.

products.name: Discourse
products.description: | Discourse is a modern forum software that is used to build communities, provide customer support and facilitate conversations. The platform is built with a focus on simplicity, user-friendliness, and responsiveness, making it accessible from both desktops and mobile devices.

products.name: DNS
products.description:
The DNS operators provide a collection of charms required to deploy a fully
functional DNS solution, facilitating the integration of DNS services with
other charms.

The goal is to provide an easy-to-use and reliable DNS deployment that offers
simple integration for existing charmed applications, enabling them to request
resource records and automate DNS processes.

products.name: Falco
products.description:
Falco is an open-source runtime security tool for physical and virtual machines.
It detects anomalous activity and potential security threats in real time.
The Falco operators include a subordinate machine charm for Falco and a Kubernetes
charm for Falcosidekick, which connects Falco to external ecosystems.

products.name: Gateway API Integrator
products.description:
The Gateway API Integrator Operator is a workload-less charm that manages external access to HTTP/HTTPS services in a Kubernetes cluster via a Gateway and an ``HTTPRoute`` resource.
This requires the Kubernetes cluster in question to have a Gateway API controller already deployed into it.

products.name: HAProxy
products.description:
HAProxy is a TCP/HTTP reverse proxy which is particularly suited for high availability environments.
It features connection persistence through HTTP cookies, load balancing, header addition, modification, deletion both ways.
It has request blocking capabilities and provides interface to display server status.

products.name: Hockeypuck
products.description:
Hockeypuck is an OpenPGP public keyserver tool used to manage public key infrastructure
for PGP (Pretty Good Privacy). PGP is a system for securing communication through
encryption and digital signatures.

products.name: HTTP Proxy
products.description:
HTTP Proxy is a collection of operators providing HTTP forward proxy capabilities.
The Squid forward proxy charm deploys and manages a Squid proxy instance as a forward proxy server.
The HTTP proxy policy charm adds a policy layer to filter and manage proxy access requests,
exposing a web interface for administrators to approve or reject HTTP proxy requests.

products.name: HTTP Request Lego Provider
products.description:
HTTP Request Lego Provider is a Juju charm deploying and managing
`HTTP request Lego provider as defined by ACME <https://go-acme.github.io/lego/dns/httpreq/>`_
on Kubernetes. It is a web application that implements the DNS HTTP request provider
to manage DNS records, enabling the automation of DNS management for ACME certificate issuance.

This charm simplifies initial deployment and operations on Kubernetes, allowing
deployment on many different Kubernetes platforms, from MicroK8s to Charmed Kubernetes
and public cloud Kubernetes offerings.

products.name: Indico
products.description:
Indico charm makes it easy for those looking to take control of their own
events management system whilst keeping operations simple, and gives them the
freedom to deploy on the Kubernetes platform of their choice.

products.name: Jenkins
products.description:
Jenkins is an extendable continuous integration server that monitors executions of repeated jobs.
The focus of Jenkins is the building/testing of software projects continuously, and monitoring
executions of externally-run jobs. This product provides the Jenkins server service with both
Kubernetes and machine agent support for flexible automation environments.

products.name: Mailserver Operators
products.description:
The Mailserver Operators product provides a suite of Juju charms for
deploying and managing a complete email server stack on machines. It consists of:
Dovecot (IMAP/POP3 mail delivery), Postfix relay (SMTP relay server),
Postfix relay configurator (subordinate charm for additional relay configuration),
and OpenDKIM (DKIM signing and verification milter).

products.name: Matrix
products.description:
Matrix is a drop in replacement for other chat servers like Mattermost and Slack.
The synapse charm is useful if you want to spin up your own chat instance.

products.name: Mattermost
products.description: Mattermost is an open-source chat platform designed for secure, real-time communication within teams.

products.name: NetBox
products.description:
From their website: NetBox is the world’s most popular ecosystem for operating, 
automating, and securing networks and infrastructure.

products.name: Nginx Ingress Integrator
products.description: The Nginx Integrator Operator is a workload-less charm that allows other charms to configure an Nginx Ingress resource.

products.name: OpenCTI
products.description: OpenCTI is an open source platform allowing organizations to manage their cyber threat intelligence knowledge and observables.

products.name: Penpot
products.description:
Penpot is a web-based, open-source design and prototyping tool that enables designers
and teams to collaborate on UI/UX projects. The penpot charm deploys Penpot on Kubernetes,
providing a scalable design collaboration platform.

products.name: Pollen
products.description:
Pollen is a scalable, high performance, free software (AGPL) web server,
that provides small strings of entropy, over TLS-encrypted HTTPS or clear
text HTTP connections.  You might think of this as 'Entropy-as-a-Service'.

products.name: SAML Integrator
products.description: | SAML Integrator is an integrator charm for providing SAML configuration details to consumer charms which seek to authenticate using a SAML server. Configure the SAML endpoint in the integrator charm and relate consumer charms as needed.

products.name: Self-hosted GitHub Actions Runner
products.description:
The Self-Hosted GitHub Runner provides self-hosted GitHub Actions Runners. Note, that there is a dedicated
documentation for our end-users available at https://documentation.ubuntu.com/self-hosted-runners/en/latest/ .
The documentation hosted here is mainly used for operational and team-internal information only.

products.name: SMTP Integrator
products.description: SMTP Integrator is an integrator that provides SMTP connection information to other charms requiring SMTP integration.

products.name: Traefik
products.description: Traefik is your all-in-one, self-hosted, cloud-native, GitOps-driven application proxy, API gateway, and API management platform.

products.name: Ubuntu MOTD
products.description:
Ubuntu servers connect to motd.ubuntu.com to retrieve the Message Of The Day (MOTD).
The MOTD may be different based on the architecture, the Ubuntu release or the public cloud.

products.name: Wazuh
products.description: A platform that unifies XDR and SIEM protection for endpoints and cloud workloads.

products.name: WireGuard gateway
products.description:
WireGuard gateway is a machine charm that deploys a highly available site-to-site VPN solution based on WireGuard.
It features automatic key exchange, OSPF-based route fault tolerance, and VRRP-based virtual redundant routing for
enterprise-grade VPN deployments.

products.name: WordPress
products.description:
A Juju charm deploying and managing WordPress on Kubernetes. It supports scaling,
ingress integration, and optional integrations like logging and monitoring. See end-user docs at
https://documentation.ubuntu.com/wordpress-k8s-charm/latest/.

test_verification.label: Test Verification
test_verification.description: Measures the breadth and reliability of automated test coverage across the product's component repositories.

coverage_pct.label: Coverage
coverage_pct.description: Percentage of source lines covered by automated tests, averaged across foundational components.

stability_pct.label: Stability
stability_pct.description: Percentage of CI runs that passed over the last 30 days.

latest_build_passing.label: Latest build passing
latest_build_passing.description: Whether the most recent CI run on the default branch is green.

uses_ops_testing.label: Uses ops.testing (no Harness)
uses_ops_testing.description: No references to the deprecated ops.testing Harness class found in test files. Checks via GitHub Search API.

uses_jubilant.label: Uses Jubilant
uses_jubilant.description: Integration tests import the Jubilant framework. Canonical standard for charm integration testing.

documentation.label: Documentation
documentation.description: Evaluates the completeness and quality of product documentation against the Diátaxis framework and Canonical style guide.

has_readme.label: README present
has_readme.description: A README.md exists in the primary component repository.

has_contributing.label: CONTRIBUTING present
has_contributing.description: A CONTRIBUTING.md guide exists, helping contributors get started.

has_security.label: SECURITY present
has_security.description: A SECURITY.md file exists with vulnerability disclosure instructions.

diataxis_coverage.label: Diátaxis coverage
diataxis_coverage.description: Number of Diátaxis doc types present (tutorial, how-to, reference, explanation). Scored by LLM analysis of the docs folder.

style_linter_passing.label: Style linter passing
style_linter_passing.description: Documentation passes the Canonical Vale style linter with no errors.

links_passing.label: Links passing
links_passing.description: All hyperlinks in documentation resolve without HTTP errors. Informational only — link checks are enforced separately by CI.

substrate_compat.label: Substrate Compatibility
substrate_compat.description: Checks that the product supports current and next-generation Juju and Charmed Kubernetes versions.

supports_juju_3.label: Juju 3 support
supports_juju_3.description: The product's charms declare compatibility with Juju 3.x in their metadata.

supports_juju_4.label: Juju 4 support
supports_juju_4.description: The product's charms declare compatibility with Juju 4.x (next-gen).

supports_ck8s.label: Charmed K8s support
supports_ck8s.description: The product is tested and documented for Charmed Kubernetes deployments.

security_ssdlc.label: Security / SSDLC
security_ssdlc.description: Verifies that the product follows the Secure Software Development Lifecycle practices mandated by Canonical's PSQF security baseline.

dependabot_enabled.label: Dependabot enabled
dependabot_enabled.description: A .github/dependabot.yml file is present in at least one foundational component repository, enabling automated dependency updates.

codeql_enabled.label: CodeQL enabled
codeql_enabled.description: At least one foundational repository has a GitHub Actions workflow that references github/codeql-action, enabling static analysis.

branch_protection_required_checks.label: Branch protection with required checks
branch_protection_required_checks.description: The default branch has at least one required status check configured in branch protection rules, preventing merging of broken code.

support_engagement.label: Support Engagement
support_engagement.description: Measures how responsive the product team is to community and customer issues and pull requests.

avg_triage_days.label: Avg. triage time
avg_triage_days.description: Average number of days between issue creation and first team response or label, over the last 90 days.

avg_pr_review_days.label: Avg. PR review time
avg_pr_review_days.description: Average number of days between PR opening and first review, over the last 90 days.

has_squad_topic.label: Squad GitHub topic
has_squad_topic.description: The primary component repository has a GitHub topic matching 'squad-*', enabling automated ownership discovery and routing.

has_jira_sync.label: Jira sync configured
has_jira_sync.description: A .github/.jira_sync_config.yaml file exists in the primary component repository, enabling GitHub-to-Jira issue synchronisation.
